newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Zalakeramia at new highs.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Zalakeramia at new highs.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian tile maker Zalakeramia Rt rose to record territory in early trading on Tuesday bolstered by news of its acquisition plans, traders said.

"The announcement of the acquisition plans definitely explain the current price increase," a trader said. "Should further information be released on the deals Zalakeramia's share price may rise further."
Zalakeramia opened at 8,200 forints, above Monday's close of 8,150, and soared to a new record of 8,500 forints. At 1116 GMT the share traded at 8,400.
"Zalakeramia is a typical example of continuous 'buy' recommendations which said it was poised for long-term growth and was well managed," the trader said.
On Monday Zalakeramia said it would hold an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on February 12 to discuss issues related to its planned acquisitions.

The tile maker said three companies were of serious interest and to fund these acquisitions the board was seeking shareholders' approval for the issue of 0.9-1.2 million new ordinary shares, to be offered privately to Hungarian and foreign institutional investors.
It also said it would use a bridging loan to finance the deals, which will be made through a new Austrian company, Eurokeramika AG, which is to be 95 percent owned by Zalakeramia.
